final: WITH g AS (SELECT ID, COUNT(*) AS n FROM Examination GROUP BY ID), f AS (SELECT ID, n, n * 1.0 / (SELECT SUM(n) FROM g) AS frac FROM g), a AS (SELECT AVG(frac) AS avg_frac FROM f) SELECT f.ID, f.n AS num_examinations, f.frac AS fraction, f.frac - a.avg_frac AS excess FROM f, a WHERE f.frac > a.avg_frac ORDER BY excess DESC LIMIT 10
